title: How to Build a Waitlist App With Viral Referrals (No Code)
summary: Build a waitlist app like Product Hunt, Superhuman, or Figma — with viral referral tracking, position display, and email automation. No developer needed.
body_markdown: Early access or priority position is the most effective reward — it costs you nothing but feels valuable to the person receiving it. Superhuman offered access. Morning Brew offered branded merchandise. Robinhood just offered a higher number. If you have a paid product, offering a discount or free month for the first users acquired through referrals can increase both referral motivation and conversion. Pick rewards your specific audience would want, not generic ones.
